title: GitHub Stats Heatmap Upgrade
description: Replace custom GitHub contributions heatmap with @bklit/heatmap-chart — a production-grade composable chart with animated cells, interactive tooltips, and theme-aware level colors.
author: PP-Namias
goals: Replace custom SVG/dot heatmap with @bklit/heatmap-chart component
Transform API contributions data into HeatmapChart column/bin format
Add animated cell enter, hover dimming, and interactive tooltip
Show stats (total, current streak, longest streak) alongside heatmap
Keep existing fallback SVG and loading/error states
out-of-scope: Changing the GitHub contributions API endpoint
Adding new API fields beyond what's already fetched
Replacing the SWR data fetching hook

stories.title: Create data transformer function
stories.description: Transform API contributions array { date, count, level } into HeatmapChart format { bin: weekIndex, bins: [{ bin: dayIndex, count, date }] }. Use getHeatmapContributionLevel for level mapping. Group by week using getDay() for row index.
tasks: Create getHeatmapContributionLevel(count) — maps count to 0-4 level
Create transformToHeatmapData(contributions) — groups days into week columns
Each column = { bin: weekIndex, bins: [{ bin: dayOfWeek, count, date: Date }] }
stories.commitMessage: feat(github): add data transformer for @bklit/heatmap-chart format

stories.title: Add chart-scale CSS variables
stories.description: Add --chart-scale-01 through --chart-scale-05 CSS variables to globals.css for light and dark themes. Map to GitHub's green scale (light: white/emerald-100/200/300/400, dark: surface/dark-emerald shades).
stories.commitMessage: style(github): add chart-scale CSS variables for heatmap theming

stories.title: Rewrite GitHubContributionsSection with @bklit
stories.description: Replace custom dot grid with HeatmapInteractionProvider + HeatmapChart + HeatmapCells + HeatmapXAxis + HeatmapYAxis + HeatmapLegend + HeatmapTooltip. Keep stats cards, loading/error states, and GitHub link. Use transformToHeatmapData to convert API data.
tasks: Replace custom grid divs with HeatmapChart composable API
Add HeatmapTooltip with custom date formatter
Keep stats cards (total, current streak, longest streak)
Keep loading spinner, error state, fallback SVG
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling animation on reduced motion

stories.title: Run build and type check
tasks: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify no type errors
Run npm run lint to verify no lint errors
Verify the component renders in the browser

api.response: { total: number, contributions: [{ date: string, count: number, level: 0|1|2|3|4 }] }

transformation.output: HeatmapColumn[] — one column per week, each with 7 bins
transformation.mapping: date string → new Date(date), count → getHeatmapContributionLevel(count), day index = getDay(date)
